name: What factors should I consider when choosing a pre-construction floor plan?

mainEntity.name: What factors should I consider when choosing a pre-construction floor plan?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a pre-construction floor plan, consider your lifestyle, family size, future needs, and how you intend to use each space. Think about bedroom count, bathroom layouts, kitchen size, open-concept versus traditional layouts, and outdoor living areas. A practical tradeoff to consider is balancing your current needs with potential future changes, as some layouts offer more flexibility for adaptation over time. For example, a home office may be crucial now, but a convertible space could serve as a guest room later. Kelby Contreras advises clients on popular design trends and functional layouts observed in the South Florida market.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider your lifestyle, family size, future needs, and space utilization, balancing current preferences with future adaptability when selecting a floor plan.
